description: This file defines a 'Loader' component using the LightningJS framework. It includes a template with animated circles indicating a loading state, defines properties such as 'loaderColor', manages internal state 'alpha' for fade effects, and includes a start method to toggle the alpha value periodically.

classes.name: Loader
classes.description: A loading animation component with fading circles designed for LightningJS frameworks.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins an interval that toggles the 'alpha' property to create a fade-in and fade-out animation for the loader circles.
